quote.summary: Suzhou Dongshan Precision Manufacturing Co., Ltd is a China-based company specializing in the manufacturing of multi-layer printed circuit boards (PCBs), precision components, touch panels, liquid crystal modules (LCMs), and optical transceivers. The Company's products are applied in consumer electronics, automobiles, data centers, communication equipment, and industrial control equipment. The Electronic Circuits (PCBs) segment includes flexible printed circuits (FPCs), rigid printed circuit boards (RPCBs), and Rigid-Flexes. The Precision Component segment includes automotive components and telecommunications equipment components. The Touch Panel and LCMs segment includes touch panels, liquid crystal display (LCD) , and organic light emitting diode (OLED) modules. The Optical Transceivers segment includes data center transceiver and telecommunications transceiver. The Other segment mainly includes the sales of light-emitting diode (LED) display products, raw and scrap materials.
